name: sapphire-weather
description: Current weather and up to seven forecast days using Open-Meteo.
author: shawnrobinson226-source

settings.label: Default location
settings.help: City with region/country. Leave empty to ask each time. Ambiguous names require coordinates.

settings.label: Forecast days
settings.help: Whole number from 1 to 7, including today.

settings.label: Request timeout (seconds)
settings.help: From 2 to 20 seconds per connection/read operation.

settings.label: Cache (minutes)
settings.help: From 1 to 60 minutes. Cached responses show their fetch time.
